(1) A verifier looking up the khmer ID derives with salt16 || SHA3(khmer ID)[0..32]: KCV mismatch -> no-match. (2) Opening with the correct K_s of floor-latin but the khmer registry key in the AAD: AEAD failure -> corrupt.
